mapper.select: SELECT stock_code, stock_name, current_price, description FROM stock ORDER BY stock_code
SELECT stock_code, stock_name, current_price, description, exchange FROM stock WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}

SELECT stock_code, stock_name, exchange FROM stock WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND (stock_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR stock_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN stock_code LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 WHEN stock_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, stock_code ASC LIMIT 8
